meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 装好后 NanoClaw 会开一个本地 HTTP 通道，你可以在 Emacs 里打开聊天缓冲区直接对话；也能把 org 标题子树或选区发出去，回复以子标题落在同一个文件里。
howto.when: 当你要求把 Emacs 加为 NanoClaw 频道，或在 Doom、Spacemacs、原生 Emacs 27.1+ 里想接上助手时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Emacs 加为 NanoClaw 的频道
say.note: 会复制适配器和 nanoclaw.el，再走注册流程

say.text: 怎么把 org 里的这段内容发给 NanoClaw？
say.note: 对应 nanoclaw-org-send，回复作为子标题插入

say.text: Emacs 频道没起来，帮我查日志和 .env
say.note: 检查 EMACS_ENABLED、import 行和端口

howto.what_en: Once installed, NanoClaw opens a local HTTP bridge so you can chat from an Emacs buffer, and send an org subtree or region with the reply landing as a child heading in the same file.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add Emacs as a NanoClaw channel, or connect Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla Emacs 27.1+ to the assistant.

say_en.text: Add Emacs as a NanoClaw channel for me
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and nanoclaw.el, then registers it

say_en.text: How do I send an org subtree to NanoClaw?
say_en.note: Uses nanoclaw-org-send; reply appears as a child heading

say_en.text: The Emacs channel won't start, check logs and .env
say_en.note: Looks at EMACS_ENABLED, the import line, and the port
